brief: On deformations of hyperbolic 3-manifolds with geodesic boundary (Frigerio, AGT 6 (2006) 435–457) — the solution variety of consistency equations for a geometric partially truncated triangulation…
extended:
**On deformations of hyperbolic 3-manifolds with geodesic boundary** — Roberto Frigerio. Algebraic & Geometric Topology 6 (2006) 435–457.

For M a complete finite-volume hyperbolic 3-manifold with compact non-empty geodesic boundary and k toric cusps, and T a geometric partially truncated triangulation of M: the variety of solutions of the consistency equations for T is a smooth manifold of real dimension 2k near the point representing the unique complete structure. Consequences follow for the relation between deformations of triangulations and deformations of the hyperbolic structure.

**Why it may bear here.** Consistency ("gluing") equations and their solution variety are the same machinery as the Ptolemy / gluing-equation material already registered (garoufalidis-goerner-zickert2012); this is the geodesic-boundary case.
